trainer/32195.htm.text: Master Sione: Welcome! It always warms my heart to meet someone of my own race. In truth, I wish I could go home. But we Kamael never abandon our mission because of personal wishes.

trainer/32195-noteach.htm.text: Master Sione: Even among the Kamael, I can only teach female Kamael Soldiers and Warders. You'd best find another master better suited to your needs.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-01.htm.text: Master Sione: While you were still training on the Isle of Souls, I was sent to the outer world to collect information. Compared to our male counterparts, we female Kamael engage in more subtle and skillful combat. I see that you have gained a bit of combat experience. If you wish to rise to the ne…
when: state CREATED; level >= 18; lacks items 9772; player.getClassId() == ClassId.femaleSoldier

We are a special force particularly suited for information gathering, reporting, determining an enemy's weaknesses, interrogating, attacking supply lines and conducting raids behind enemy lines. These activities suit the natu…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-09.html.text: Master Sione: What is it, soldier? Have you completed your mission? Go to the Abandoned Camp and defeat the Ol Mahum Novices as ordered and obtain 10 Ol Mahum orders . Then eliminate the Ol Mahum Patrols and obtain 5 Ol Mahum marks ...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-10.html.text: Master Sione: Well done! (Reads the document carefully.) Let's see here... These reports are useful. The target that we want is the Ol Mahum Officer Tak. We also have reports from the other races near the Abandoned Camp who have also been attacked. When I have finished writing my report, deliver it…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-11.html.text: Master Sione: Take the report I gave you to Gobie in the Town of Gludio ... Move!

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-12.html.text: Master Sione: How are you progressing with the Steelrazor test, which is part of your class transfer test? May you succeed and become a great Warder...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-13.html.text: Master Sione: Hmm, some... Ah, it's you. So how goes your test? ... Ah, this is Gobie's report. Well done, soldier. Return to Gobie and bring back the next set of orders.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32195-05.htm.text: Master Selsia: I see... For you to obtain the right to become a Warder, you must pass the Steelrazor test for the Kamael special forces unit. Be warned: you will be tested by experienced warriors who have developed their skills as Warders... I am in charge of class transfer, but there is also a com…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
